title: Production positive-matched sign-structure control for Figure S3
purpose: Production-scale refresh of the supplementary positive-matched control.
rationale: Use the same 1000-replicate convention as the other production figures.
Keep the control focused on sigma_env=0.5, matching the existing sign-structure display and the Figure 3 mechanism setting.
Compare mixed, positive-matched, and aligned-positive slope regimes at S=4 and S=8 so the effect of response sign can be separated from slope-magnitude distribution.
Use a non-negative rho_env grid from 0 to 1 to align the x-axis with the production Figure 3 synchrony display and avoid infeasible negative equicorrelation complications.
acceptance_checks: The combined parquet validates against the production manifest.
Rows equal 66000, with 1000 replicates for every scenario.
rho_eff and rho_clipped are present and manifest-consistent.
Positive-matched CV and realised-correlation patterns sit between mixed and aligned-positive regimes where sign structure matters.
Mean extinction or floor occupancy is summarised before replacing the Figure S3 display.
